tui_update_up_to_date: Up to date on this channel

help_common_command_groups:
profile                   Add, switch, and update subscriptions. See cor profile help.
  node                      Pick and test nodes. See cor node help.
help_describe_agent_guide: Read the built-in guide for AI agents.
help_describe_claude_audit: Inspect the current terminal environment and recorded Claude project settings.
help_describe_claude_browser: Open a local browser probe and wait for its report.
help_describe_claude_check: Check regional signals from the local network and Claude environment.
help_describe_claude_protect: Show or toggle Claude protection. Enabling it requires confirmation.
help_describe_claude_watch: Watch unusual connections and block events live.
help_describe_completion: Generate context-sensitive completion for Bash, Zsh, Fish, or PowerShell.
help_describe_config_check: Use the core to validate the effective configuration.
help_describe_config_effective: Print effective YAML with rule overrides. Credentials are redacted by default.
help_describe_config_get: Read settings. Secrets are redacted by default.
help_describe_config_set: Validate and apply a setting. Use mode or proxy to change network mode.
help_describe_connection_list: List connections with upload and download rates and totals. Supports filtering, sorting, and live sampling.
help_describe_connection_show: Show connection details, resolving the destination IP when needed.
help_describe_diagnose: Diagnose networking. Use --output to save a report and --offline to collect local data only.
help_describe_dns: Look up addresses using core or system DNS.
help_describe_env: Print proxy environment variables for the parent shell to load.
help_describe_geo_update: Verify and update all Geo data.
help_describe_ip_check: Run all checks, one category, or a single check and summarize the results.
help_describe_ip_check_list: List the available IP and region checks.
help_describe_logs: View logs with level and text filters or follow live output.
help_describe_logs_export: Export up to 500 buffered log entries. Use diagnose --output to capture diagnostics.
help_describe_mode: Show or switch between rule, global, and direct modes.
help_describe_network_check: Check a URL’s DNS, response, and the proxy route used.
help_describe_network_config_diff: Removed. Use config get, config check, or config effective.
help_describe_network_dns: Compare system DNS with the core’s DNS.
help_describe_network_download: Run a time- and size-limited download and discard the response body.
help_describe_network_explain: Removed. Use network check to see matched rules and outbound routes.
help_describe_network_http: Inspect HTTP response details within the configured limits.
help_describe_network_node: Removed. Node details are on the Proxies page.
help_describe_network_phase: Measure TCP, TLS, and time to first byte.
help_describe_network_rule: Removed. Use network check to see the matched rule.
help_describe_network_stability: Check whether repeated requests succeed over a short interval.
help_describe_network_tcp: Check TCP connectivity to a specified port.
help_describe_network_tls: Inspect the HTTPS certificate and trust chain.
help_describe_network_traffic: Removed. Use connection list to inspect current connections.
help_describe_network_udp: Check DNS responses over the core’s UDP relay.
help_describe_node_list: List proxy groups or their members, sorted by name or latency.
help_describe_node_select: Choose a node in a proxy group. Omit arguments for an interactive picker. Protection locks node selection.
help_describe_node_test: Test latency for one node, one group, or all nodes. Automatic groups reselect their preferred node.
help_describe_notify: Send a system notification through the Claude protection notification path.
help_describe_profile_add: Import a subscription from a URL, YAML path, or standard input (-).
help_describe_profile_edit: Edit the subscription name or source. Update it to load the new source.
help_describe_profile_export: Export cached YAML. Use --show-secrets to include credentials.
help_describe_profile_import: Import a subscription from a YAML file or standard input (-).
help_describe_profile_list: List subscriptions. Source credentials are redacted by default.
help_describe_profile_remove: Remove a subscription. Removing the active one switches to the built-in direct profile.
help_describe_profile_update: Update one subscription or all user subscriptions.
help_describe_profile_use: Switch the active subscription by unique name or ID.
help_describe_proxy: Show or switch between system proxy, TUN, and off.
help_describe_restart: Restart the core. Use --network-only to refresh outbound routes and DNS and close old connections.
help_describe_rule_add: Validate, save, and apply a new custom rule.
help_describe_rule_edit: Edit a custom rule. Subscription rules are read-only.
help_describe_rule_enable: Enable or disable a custom rule.
help_describe_rule_list: Show effective rules, sources, and stable IDs for the selected or active subscription.
help_describe_rule_move: Move a rule to a position starting at 1.
help_describe_rule_shortcut: Show or change five rule shortcuts. Existing subscription rules are reused.
help_describe_run: Run the backend and core in the foreground. Ctrl+C restores networking and exits.
help_describe_service_install: Install headless backend autostart for the current user.
help_describe_service_remove: Remove CLI backend autostart for the current user.
help_describe_service_status: Show the CLI backend autostart configuration.
help_describe_start: Start the backend and core, reusing the running desktop app if available.
help_describe_status: Show the core status, subscription, nodes, mode, and live traffic.
help_describe_stop: Stop the core, restore networking, and exit a standalone backend.
help_describe_ui: Open the terminal interface. The backend and proxy stay running when you exit.
help_describe_update_check: Check for client updates on the saved update channel.
help_describe_update_download: Download and verify an installer from the current update channel.
help_describe_update_install: Download and install an update. On Linux, start the backend after success or restore its previous state on failure.
help_describe_update_status: Show this account’s last update result without starting the backend.
help_describe_version: Show the client version and machine architecture.
help_example_profile_import: cat profile.yaml | cor profile import - --name 'Local subscription'
help_footer:
Run cor help <command> for details. See docs/cli.md for the CLI guide.
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 operation failed, 2 invalid arguments, 3 backend unavailable, 124 timed out, 130 cancelled.
help_group_excludes_subcommand_options: Group help does not accept command-specific options
help_option_all_users: On Linux, let root view subscriptions or TUN processes across users.
help_option_category: Check category, such as AI, 全球, or 日本.
help_option_demo: Preview the terminal interface with mock data and no network changes.
help_option_details: Show all checks, explanations, and sources.
help_option_group: Test only the specified proxy group.
help_option_help: Show help for this command and its options (-h).
help_option_jsonl: Output one JSON record per line, including live samples.
help_option_level: Log level: debug, info, warning, error, or silent.
help_option_method: HTTP method: HEAD, GET, or OPTIONS (default: HEAD).
help_option_network_only: Refresh outbound routes and DNS and close old connections without restarting the core.
help_option_no_color: Use plain text. CLI output is plain by default.
help_option_no_core: Start the backend without starting the core.
help_option_no_start: Preserve the core's previous running state after a Linux update.
help_option_offline: Collect local information without contacting external check services.
help_option_open: Open the local probe in the default browser.
help_option_output: Write to a file (-o). Full logs and configurations are private to the current user.
help_option_profile: Select a subscription by unique name or ID (default: active subscription).
help_option_resources: Use a directory containing the core and Geo resources.
help_option_reverse: Reverse the sort order. Names ascend by default and rates and totals descend.
help_option_seconds: Time limit per request in seconds (1–30, default: 10).
help_option_shell: Environment syntax: bash, zsh, fish, powershell, or cmd.
help_option_show_secrets: Include full credentials in subscription and configuration output.
help_option_sort: Sort by name or latency for nodes. Connections also support rule, chain, upload, download, upload-rate, download-rate, and start.
help_option_source: Subscription URL or local YAML path.
help_option_system: Use system DNS. The default is core DNS.
help_option_type: DNS record type (default: ADDR, which checks A and AAAA).
help_option_unset: Print shell commands to clear proxy environment variables.
help_option_user: On Linux, administer another user's settings and backend as that user.
help_option_watch: Stream new samples or log entries until Ctrl+C.
help_option_yes: Confirm removal, protection, installation, or similar operations (-y).
option_all_users_proxy_is_read_only: --all-users is read-only and cannot switch the proxy
option_interval_out_of_range: The sampling interval must be 0.25–3600 seconds
option_language_description: Choose the language for this command or terminal interface.
output_connections_offline: Core stopped; no active connections. This query did not start the core.
output_delay_all_failed: All nodes are unreachable. Choose another node; updates retry directly after a failure.
output_delay_summary: Speed test complete: {available} reachable, {failed} timed out or unreachable
output_diagnose_http_detail: HTTP {status} · Response header time, not ICMP latency
output_diagnose_offline: Local evidence only; no network tests or background connection. Save the full report with --output cor-diagnose.json.
output_diagnose_system_http: System route HTTP (without proxy environment variables)
output_nodes_offline: Core stopped; showing saved subscriptions without latency tests. Remote providers and dynamic members are not expanded.

output_status_and_proxy_hint: Status: cor status · Turn off proxy: cor proxy off
output_status_reference_route_hint: Other rules may route connections differently; run cor connection list
